Name: Jen's Storage Cabins
Author: jenf1
Description:
[size=3][b]This mod is only available here at Nexus Mods! If you see it anywhere else, it has been uploaded without my permission and should be taken down immediately![/b][/size]

Want to clear your cabins for storage or additional decorating space? I got'chu.

[size=5]Features:[/size]

- Cabins empty kitchens, for a wide open space to use however you like
- Slightly bigger starter cabin
- Removal of walls separating the rooms for even more space
- All walls and floors can be customized

[size=5]A few closing notes:[/size]

- This mod is intended for singleplayer use.
- Seed box removal, bed removal, and cabin upgrades in singleplayer can only be achieved with the use of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21233]Anything Anywhere[/url].
- The crib and all renovations are disabled.

[size=6]Modded farmhouses will not work with this mod unless they have a config option for cabins![/size]

As of writing this (6/28/24) the only known compatible modded farmhouses are Seasonal Garden Farmhouse V2, Lune Farmhouse, and Aimon's Tidy Cozy
Farmhouse (version 2.0.4). The others will need configs in order to be
made compatible. When I have time, I will reach out to authors of modded
farmhouses and request configs to be added.

- Recolor used in the screenshots is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14790]DaisyNiko's Earthy Interiors[/url]. It is NOT required for this mod to work.

[size=5]Known Issues:[/size]

- Crafted flooring placed on the floors in areas that don't have flooring in the corresponding vanilla map areas will disappear upon ending the day. This is caused by a piece of code that is unfortunately essential to keeping the cabin map separate from the farmhouse. Until I can find a better way to separate cabin and farmhouse maps, this is something that I cannot fix.

[size=5]Install:[/size]

- Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16507]Farmhouse Fixes[/url].
- Copy [CP] Jen's Storage Cabins into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder
- Load the game using SMAPI and enjoy!
